editorialLanding.heroSub: CloseBoss texts and emails every new buyer and seller inquiry in under 60 seconds — in your voice, on your number — then hands the warm ones back to you ready to tour.
editorialLanding.worksWith: Works with Zillow, Realtor, FUB, IDX
editorialLanding.demoLead: Sarah M., 555-0147, interested in 2418 Oakhurst Dr.
editorialLanding.demoAgent1: Hi Sarah, this is Mark with Windermere — saw you asked about 2418 Oakhurst. Are you hoping to tour this weekend or just gathering info for now?
editorialLanding.demoBuyer: This weekend, if possible. Saturday afternoon?
editorialLanding.demoAgent2: Perfect — I have 1pm or 3:30pm open. I'll send a calendar hold. Quick thing: are you already working with a lender, or should I introduce you to someone?
editorialLanding.quote: I closed three deals in my trial that would have ghosted me in week one.
editorialLanding.videoBefore: Watch CloseBoss turn a cold Zillow inquiry into a
editorialLanding.problemP1: Every agent we talk to has tried the same playbook. More Zillow spend. Facebook lead gen. Two IDX sites. A landing page that converts at 3%. The leads come in — and then what?
editorialLanding.problemP2: The problem isn't that your leads are bad. It's that by the time you see the Zillow alert, they've already heard back from someone else. They filled out four forms on a Saturday morning; they're touring with whoever texted them first.
editorialLanding.problemP3: CloseBoss closes that five-minute window. Every new inquiry gets a reply in your voice, on your number, before you've finished your coffee. The warm ones come back to you. The tire-kickers stay in a drip. You spend your day on the three people who are actually going to close.
editorialLanding.footerBlurb: AI-powered lead follow-up, scoring, and pipeline management. Built for real estate agents who close.
